templates.intent: Typed aggregation function over a foreach loop.

files.main.php:
<?php

// Aggregate a packed integer row.
function sum_all(array $items): int {
	$total = 0;
	foreach ($items as $item) {
		$total = $total + $item;
	}

	return $total;
}

// Deterministic aggregate output.
echo sum_all([1, 2, 3, 4]), "\n";

	if ($id === 1) {
		return "alpha";
	}

	return null;
}

if ($first !== null) {
	echo $first, "\n";
}

if ($second === null) {
	echo "missing\n";
}
